criteria.description: FilterContext passes 300 (not 0) as the delayMs argument to useDebounce for non-empty search values.
criteria.evidence: FilterContext.tsx line 49: `useDebounce(search, search === '' ? 0 : 300)` — non-empty search uses 300. Tests 'typing a search term eventually filters the product list' (420ms) and 'search is case-insensitive' (365ms) both PASSED in debounceSearch.test.tsx.

criteria.description: When search is set to '' (field cleared), debouncedSearch becomes '' immediately with no 300ms wait.
criteria.evidence: FilterContext.tsx line 49: `search === '' ? 0 : 300` — delayMs is 0 when search is '', so useEffect fires synchronously via a 0ms setTimeout. 'clearing the search field restores all products' PASSED in debounceSearch.test.tsx (70ms).

criteria.description: Any pending debounce timeout for a stale non-empty value is cancelled when search is set to ''.
criteria.evidence: useDebounce.ts lines 6-9: useEffect returns `() => clearTimeout(timer)` — cleanup cancels the previous timer on every value/delay change. 'clearing the search field restores all products' PASSED and count = 15 (not a filtered subset).

criteria.description: Rapid successive keystrokes reset the 300ms window on each keystroke — only the final value applies.
criteria.evidence: 'typing a search term eventually filters the product list' PASSED (420ms) in debounceSearch.test.tsx — types 'wireless', waits, count settles to 1. The clearTimeout cleanup in useDebounce ensures intermediate values never fire.

criteria.description: If FilterProvider unmounts while a debounce is pending, the timeout is cancelled and no state update occurs on an unmounted component.
criteria.evidence: useDebounce.ts line 8: `return () => clearTimeout(timer)` is present. Full test run of 22 tests across 7 files produced no console output matching 'Can't perform a React state update on an unmounted component'. All 22 tests PASSED.
